entities.name: Bechuanaland Protectorate Administration
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Minimal British administration governed from Mafikeng (outside the territory); indirect rule through Tswana chiefs; deliberate underdevelopment; resistance to incorporation into South Africa.
